MEMO 02 — RACHE BARTMOSS & THE 2022 DATAKRASH: Legendary netrunner Rache Bartmoss hid his frozen body inside a cryo-fridge wired to a deadman's switch. MEMO 03 — THE BLACKWALL: After the Net burned, NetWatch raised the Blackwall—less a firewall and more an artificial sentinel standing guard against rogue Old Net AIs clawing from the other side of cracked glass.

SPARKY STREET FILE // VOL. 3: SMART-LINKS, TIME OF THE RED & UNIFICATION WAR

MEMO 01 — SMART GUNS VS. DERMAL JAMMERS: Smart firearms pair guided micro-gyro projectiles with a hand Smart-Link to arc around concrete cover. Wait until you meet Tyger Claws carrying military dermal tattoos: those inked transponders actively bend incoming Smart rounds wide unless you strip their jammer pylon, blind/wipe their optics, or bring an iconic targeting bypass.

MEMO 02 — THE 2023 ARASAKA TOWER NUKE & TIME OF THE RED: During the Fourth Corporate War on August 20, 2023, a Militech strike team—including Morgan Blackhand and Johnny Silverhand—detonated a pocket nuclear charge inside Arasaka's Night City Tower. The fallout turned the sky blood-crimson for years ('The Time of the Red'), forged the City Center rubble heap, and left corpses buried under steel that corpses still deny.

MEMO 03 — UNIFICATION WAR (2069–2070) & TYGER CLAWS: When NUSA President Rosalind Myers and Militech launched a blitz to force Free States back under Washington rule, Night City seemed doomed—until Saburo Arasaka sailed a supercarrier into Coronado Bay. Arasaka kept Night City formally independent... while wiring street muscle like the Tyger Claws with corporate weapons and smuggling corridors across Kabuki and Japantown.
